name: Goumaz Campground
note: Lassen NF (Eagle Lake RD) small drive-in campground, 5 sites on the Susan River beside the Bizz Johnson Trail; vault toilet, seasonal potable water, FCFS; Hwy 44 access recommended when towing trailers, open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: Big Pine Campground
note: Lassen NF (Hat Creek RD) drive-in campground, ~19 sites under tall pines along Hat Creek, 1 mi south of Old Station on SR 44/89; FCFS (fee on arrival), open ~Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Bogard Campground
note: Lassen NF (Eagle Lake RD) primitive drive-in campground, 10 sites by Pine Creek amid aspens, 1.75 mi off Hwy 44; vault toilets, hand-pump water, max RV 25 ft, FCFS, seasonal (opens after snowmelt). --Claude

name: Butte Creek Campground
note: Lassen NF (Eagle Lake RD) semi-developed drive-in campground, 10 sites along Butte Creek ~4 mi off Hwy 44; vault toilets at both ends, no potable water, FCFS, quiet/off the beaten path, seasonal. --Claude

name: Crater Lake Campground
note: Lassen NF (Eagle Lake RD) drive-in campground, 17 sites on Crater Lake (no gas motors; fly-fishing/canoeing), 7 mi off Hwy 44; fire rings/tables, hand-pump water, vault toilets, FCFS, open ~Jun-Oct. Access road is rough and steep - large motorhomes/trailers are discouraged, but a compact 23-ft rig can manage. --Claude

name: Cave Campground
note: Lassen NF (Hat Creek RD) developed campground right on Hat Creek, ~46 drive-in sites with fire rings/BBQs, flush toilets, potable water; 1/4 mi north of the Hwy 44/89 jct at Old Station; FCFS, open ~Apr-Oct (North Loop temporarily closed). --Claude

name: Bridge Campground
note: Lassen NF (Hat Creek RD) drive-in campground, ~24 sites along Hat Creek ~4 mi north of Old Station on Hwy 89; vault toilets, no potable water, low-fee FCFS, open ~Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Willow Creek Campground
note: Small 8-site FCFS Forest Service campground in the Big Valley Ranger District (Modoc NF) near Adin; per the FS page it is easy to navigate in and out with small trailers and motorhomes, vault-toilet-level facilities, no potable water, and a tiny creek runs between the campground and the day-use picnic area. 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Upper Rush Creek Campground
note: Primitive 13-site FCFS Forest Service campground densely shaded along Rush Creek, Big Valley Ranger District (Modoc NF); picnic tables only, no restrooms or potable water. FS 2025 condition note says the access road is rough but passable, so best for smaller rigs. 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Cottonwood Flat Campground
note: Remote handful-of-sites (~5) FCFS Forest Service campground on the Devil's Garden plateau near Canby (Modoc NF), adjacent to a meadow; primitive - no restrooms or potable water. Reached by Devil's Garden gravel roads (drive-in). Open ~May-Oct, 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Lava Camp
note: Remote primitive FCFS Forest Service campground in open juniper woodland, Big Valley Ranger District (Modoc NF) near Adin/the Medicine Lake highlands; pack-in/pack-out, no potable water, no trash or restroom service. Drive-in off forest roads through open terrain. 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Howard's Gulch Campground
note: 11-site FCFS Forest Service campground set in a tree-lined gulch just off Highway 139, Devil's Garden Ranger District (Modoc NF) near Canby; vault toilets and a short hiking trail, drinking-water system under repair (bring water). Drive-in with paved-highway access. Open mid-May to late Oct. --Claude

name: Big Sage Campground
note: FCFS Forest Service campground on Big Sage Reservoir near Alturas (Modoc NF), surrounded by juniper and sagebrush; ~11 sites, vault toilet, picnic tables, no potable water, dirt boat launch. Open mid-May to late Oct. --Claude

name: Janes Reservoir Campground
note: Primitive FCFS Forest Service campground circling the southeast shore of Janes Reservoir on the Devil's Garden plateau (Modoc NF) near Alturas; ~8 sites, 2 vault toilets, picnic tables, no potable water, dirt boat ramp. Reached via ~29 mi of Crowder Flat Rd (gravel/dirt, drive-in). Open ~mid-May to late Oct. --Claude

name: Sweetwater Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Groveland RD) campground adjacent to Hwy 120 about 15 mi east of Groveland, near Yosemite's Big Oak Flat entrance; 13 units for tents and RVs (max 32 ft), vault toilets, potable water, no hookups. First-come, first-served (cash/check). --Claude

name: Cherry Valley Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Groveland RD) campground near Cherry Lake in the Hetch Hetchy watershed; 46 sites (41 single, 5 double), vault toilets, no hookups, first-come first-served (cash/check). Lake ~1.5 mi via trail; boat ramp near the dam. Motorhomes to 24 ft OK - reach via Cottonwood Rd from Tuolumne (Cherry Lake Rd is narrow/steep, not advised for RVs). Open May-Sept. --Claude

name: Hull Creek Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Sugar Pine RD) 23-site campground in mixed conifer along Hull Creek, popular OHV staging area; vault toilets, no hookups, bring water, first-come first-served (cash). Reached via dirt FR 3N01, ~12 mi SE of Long Barn. Open May-Dec. --Claude

name: Fraser Flat Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Sugar Pine RD) 38-site campground on the South Fork Stanislaus River, operated by the Dodge Ridge concession; vault toilets, ADA fishing piers, no hookups, first-come first-served (cash). Access via narrow Fraser Flat Rd, 3 mi N of Hwy 108 at Spring Gap; RV dump station on Hwy 108 near Pinecrest Lake Rd. Open Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Leavitt Meadows Campground
note: First-come, first-served Humboldt-Toiyabe NF (Bridgeport RD) campground nestled among Jeffrey pines along the West Walker River off Hwy 108, ~7,600 ft; 16 drive-in sites, vault toilets, no hookups; rigs to 24 ft per rec.gov. --Claude

name: Baker Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Summit RD) campground on the Middle Fork Stanislaus River near the Kennedy Meadows junction off Hwy 108, ~6,200 ft; 44 drive-in sites in a mixed-conifer flat, water hydrants, vault toilets, no hookups. First-come, first-served (per rec.gov facility record). --Claude

name: Eureka Valley Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Summit RD) campground on the Middle Fork Stanislaus River off Hwy 108 east of Dardanelle, ~6,050 ft; 27 drive-in sites, vault toilets, no hookups; surrounding forest burned in the 2018 Donnell Fire (satellite). First-come, first-served (per rec.gov facility record). --Claude

name: Brightman Flat Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Summit RD) campground on the Middle Fork Stanislaus River off Hwy 108 west of Dardanelle, ~5,700 ft; 33 drive-in sites, vault toilets, no hookups; area burned in the 2018 Donnell Fire (satellite). First-come, first-served (per rec.gov facility record). --Claude

name: Clark Fork Campground
note: Large Stanislaus NF (Summit RD) campground on the Clark Fork of the Stanislaus River ~5 mi up Clark Fork Rd off Hwy 108, ~6,150 ft; 88 sites in two paved loops (A-loop 28 sites w/ vault toilets, B-loop 60 sites w/ flush toilets), water hydrants, RV dump station ($6), no hookups. First-come, first-served (per rec.gov). --Claude

name: Big Meadow Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Calaveras RD) campground on Hwy 4 ~25 mi east of Arnold, ~6,550 ft; 65 individual first-come sites plus a reservable group site, vault toilets, no hookups; Lake Alpine and Spicer Reservoir a short drive away (not adjacent). Individual sites FCFS (cash); group reservable online. --Claude

name: Fence Creek Campground
note: Stanislaus NF (Summit RD) campground on Fence Creek near the base of Clark Fork Rd off Hwy 108, ~5,700 ft; 38 drive-in sites in mixed conifer high above the Clark Fork of the Stanislaus, vault toilets, no hookups. First-come, first-served (per rec.gov facility record). --Claude

name: Capps Crossing Campground
note: Small Eldorado NF campground on the North Fork Cosumnes River near Grizzly Flats (~5,100 ft), reached via Sly Park Rd/Mormon Emigrant Trail and North-South Rd. 9 sites total (1 group + individuals); sites 1, 6 and 7 fit RVs while 2-5 are tent-only. Reservable online, group-oriented; individual sites FCFS when not group-booked. In the 2021 Caldor Fire burn area. --Claude

name: Camino Cove Campground
note: Eldorado NF FCFS drive-in campground on the NW shore/peninsula of Union Valley Reservoir; ~32 sites, vault toilets, no potable water. Bumpy rocky dirt access road but passable by a normal vehicle (reviewers brought 25-32 ft RVs); listed max 45 ft. --Claude

name: Jones Fork Campground
note: Eldorado NF FCFS drive-in campground on the Jones Fork arm of Union Valley Reservoir (off Ice House Rd); ~10 sites, tight loop, RVs to ~35 ft (a 28-ft toy hauler fit per review), open ~Jun-Sep. --Claude

name: Big Meadows Campground
note: Eldorado NF (Georgetown RD) FCFS drive-in campground near Hell Hole Reservoir, ~22 mi E of Georgetown via Wentworth Springs Rd; RVs to 40 ft, no hookups, open ~May-Nov. --Claude

name: Lake Forest Campground
note: Tahoe City Public Utility District campground near Lake Forest Beach on Lake Tahoe's northwest shore (2500 Lake Forest Rd, Tahoe City), 20 drive-in sites, RVs to 25 ft, pump water and portable restrooms, no hookups/showers/dump; first-come, first-served (10-day max). --Claude

name: Lookout Campground
note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF campground in the Dog Valley area northwest of Verdi, ~17-18 standard non-electric sites (most short, ~15 ft; two sites accommodate rigs to ~30 ft), vault toilets, no hookups. First-come, first-served (one reservable group picnic area). Larger sites only fit a 23-ft rig. --Claude

name: Grizzly Campground
note: Plumas NF campground on the east shore of Lake Davis (Beckwourth RD), ~58 single-family standard non-electric sites, vault toilets, no hookups; drive-in sites take RVs to ~55 ft. A portion of sites FCFS, remainder reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Conklin Park Campground
note: Small, primitive Plumas National Forest campground (~9 sites) in the Diamond Mountains south of Antelope Lake near Portola, reached by a graded forest road off the Genesee/Antelope area; vault toilet, no potable water, no hookups, first-come first-served. Best suited to smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Laufman Campground
note: Small Plumas National Forest campground (~6 sites) in a wooded canyon of the Diamond Mountains near Milford, reached from US-395 via a graded forest road; primitive, vault toilet, no hookups, first-come first-served. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Blue Lake Campground
note: Modoc National Forest campground on Blue Lake (Warner Mountain Ranger District), ~48 sites in wooded loops with a boat ramp, fishing pier and swim area; potable water and vault toilets, no hookups. Individual sites first-come first-served; a group site is reservable online. Wooded loops accommodate small-to-mid RVs. --Claude

name: Plum Valley Campground
note: Small Modoc National Forest campground (~7 sites) on the South Fork of Davis Creek near Davis Creek, Warner Mountain Ranger District, reached by a graded forest road; primitive, vault toilet, no hookups, first-come first-served. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Lassen Creek Campground
note: Small Modoc National Forest campground (~6 sites) on Lassen Creek near Willow Ranch/Fort Bidwell, Warner Mountain Ranger District, reached by a graded forest road off US-395; primitive, vault toilet, no hookups, first-come first-served. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Oak Flat Campground
note: Angeles National Forest campground off Templin Highway near Castaic (Santa Clara/Mojave River RD); drive-in sites under oaks, vault toilets, no potable water, no hookups, first-come first-served. Adventure Pass area. --Claude

name: Bear Campground
note: Small, primitive Angeles National Forest campground (~8 sites) on the Sawmill-Liebre ridge near Lake Hughes, reached by a graded dirt forest road; recently improved with new fire rings and bear-proof lockers; vault toilet, no water, no hookups, first-come first-served. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Hardluck Campground
note: Los Padres National Forest campground on Piru Creek below Pyramid Lake (Mount Pinos Ranger District), reached via Lockwood Valley Rd and graded-dirt Gold Hill Rd; ~26 primitive creekside sites, vault toilets, no potable water, no hookups, first-come first-served. Popular creek-camping spot; graded dirt access passable to careful drivers. --Claude
